customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in CI and the Makefile, each marked with a renovate comment. One manager rather than one per variable, so a new pin only needs its comment.

kyverno-policy-crds: its own version and its one dependency's are the same number, the kyverno-api version it wraps. One manager matches both `version:` lines so a bump moves them together and the result is published under the version it contains.

packageRules.description: CI dependencies, grouped and automerged as in ankhmorpork.
The helmv3 manager would bump kyverno-policy-crds' dependency on its own and leave the chart version behind, which publishes nothing. The regex manager above owns that file.

The wrapper's one dependency moves whenever upstream publishes a kyverno-api; land it at once. A CRD-only chart runs no code and changes additively, so the soak that guards application bumps against early bugs and supply-chain compromise buys nothing here -- and ankhmorpork's kyverno bump cannot pass validate-kyverno-crd-pin until the newer wrapper exists.
